rules.note: draw_badge paints the pill and places the badge's text, so a pill painted in the pill's colours, its corner radius, a pill rectangle or a centred badge text anywhere else under src is a second badge drawer. badge_pill.h is scanned too: only draw_badge's own lines and the definitions it uses are listed, so a second drawer added beside it fails as well. draw_badge paints the colours its caller gives in PillColors, the shared pill's by default; the Dynamic Hit Window tag passes window_tag_pill. A rect painted in the tag's colours (window_tag_fill, window_tag_ink or window_tag_pill) anywhere under src is a second drawer too. draw_window_tag, window_tag_width and any kWindowTag constant are refused everywhere, badge_pill.h included: the Dynamic Hit Window tag is a badge, drawn by draw_badge at shared_pill_width. The squeeze box reads the pill's colours through pill_vec4 for its own box shape, which this row lets through. Tests are out of scope: they call pill_rect and centred_text_x to check the owner, and the GUI test reads pill_u32 to find drawn pills.
